definitions.explanation: A rice bowl topped with three different colored toppings, typically scrambled egg (yellow), seasoned ground meat (brown), and green vegetables such as blanched spinach or green beans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三色丼|さんしょくどん}です。
examples.english: Today's lunch is a three-color rice bowl.

examples.japanese: {三色丼|さんしょくどん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彩|いろど}り→彩り：12506_irodori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧で{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The three-color rice bowl is colorful and popular with children.

examples.japanese: {鶏|とり}そぼろ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{炒|い}り{卵|たまご}→炒り卵：26099_iritamago⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦インゲン→インゲン：10234_ingen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三色丼|さんしょくどん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a three-color rice bowl with seasoned ground chicken, scrambled egg, and green beans.

notes:
A compound of {三色|さんしょく} (three colors) and {丼|どん} (rice bowl). The visual appeal of three contrasting colors arranged on white rice is the defining feature. A staple of home cooking and school lunch menus in Japan.

TYPICAL TOPPINGS:
- ⟦{黄|き}→黄：19352_ki⟧: ⟦{炒|い}り{卵|たまご}→炒り卵：26099_iritamago⟧ (scrambled egg)
- ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧: {鶏|とり}そぼろ or ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧⟦そぼろ→そぼろ：10383_soboro⟧ (seasoned ground chicken or pork)
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧: さや⟦インゲン→インゲン：10234_ingen⟧, ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧, {絹|きぬ}さや (green beans, spinach, snow peas)
